hints: Identify the lower limit of integration as the $y$-intercept at $y = 1$.
Set up the volume integral $V = \pi \int_1^5 (y - 1) dy$ and evaluate.
walkthrough:
Rearrange the curve equation to express $x^2$ in terms of $y$:
$$y = x^2 + 1 \implies x^2 = y - 1$$

Find the lower integration limit at the $y$-axis intercept ($x = 0$):
$$y = 0^2 + 1 = 1$$

Set up and evaluate the definite integral for the volume generated by rotating about the $y$-axis from $y = 1$ to $y = 5$:
$$V = \pi \int_1^5 x^2 dy = \pi \int_1^5 (y - 1) dy = \pi \left[ \frac{1}{2}y^2 - y \right]_1^5$$
